name: kg-navigation
description: How an agent finds the knowledge graph it is standing in. Named here rather than inferred from the directory: every instance's skills live in a directory called `skills`, so a package id taken from the basename makes this one indistinguishable from cat-harness/src/skills, kg-navigation's, large-datasets' and who-iris's. Before this manifest a `seen` Set silently dropped whichever arrived second and every signal read healthy — bean `nlvl`, surfaced by `r1vw` turning that silence into a reported problem.
